challenge.title: Goal: Digital Transformation in Gastronomy
challenge.text: Modern restaurants need more than just delicious food. In the digital age, efficient management of orders, reservations, and customer relationships is crucial, as is ensuring a smooth online experience. The project aimed to support the restaurant in these areas, increase its online reach, and improve customer service quality by automating key processes and providing tools for effective business management.

solution.title: My Solution: Architecture and Implementation
solution.text: The implemented solution includes a responsive website for the restaurant with online payment system, enabling menu management, online ordering, online payments, and customer account management. The system automates the ordering and reservation processes, integrates payments, and the administrative panel allows for efficient management of customer data and orders. Additionally, analytics mechanisms and tools for monitoring traffic and user behavior were implemented, supporting informed business decisions and increasing staff efficiency.

frontend.title: Frontend – User Interface and Customer Experience:
frontend.text1: For the frontend, I chose React.js combined with Mantine UI, which allowed me to quickly build rich and accessible components. This gives customers an intuitive interface for browsing the menu, customizing orders, and making table reservations. I paid particular attention to responsiveness, ensuring seamless operation on all devices – from desktops to smartphones.
frontend.text2: The management panel is a comprehensive tool that gives staff full control over restaurant operations. From monitoring sales on the dashboard, to managing products, categories, and handling orders, customers, and reservations. The implementation of user roles (admin, moderator, member) ensures precise access control.

backend.title: Backend – The Heart of the System:
backend.text: The backend, built on Node.js using Express.js and the MongoDB database, provides a solid foundation for all operations. I developed a RESTful API that handles the management of products, orders, users, and reservations. Key considerations were ensuring security (JWT for authorization, OAuth for social login) and scalability so the system could grow with the restaurant.

achievements.title: What was achieved:
achievements.f1: Comprehensive Integration: The frontend was connected to the backend, the Stripe payment system, and authorization mechanisms (JWT, Google/Facebook OAuth), creating a coherent and secure application environment.
achievements.f2: Responsive Design: The site adapts to various devices, ensuring consistent operation on both desktops and mobile devices.
achievements.f3: Performance Optimization: Images and content load progressively as the page is used, and server queries were optimized, making the application run smoothly and quickly.
achievements.f4: Efficient Data Management: The system enables efficient processing and control of information within the application.
achievements.f5: Clean Code and Best Practices: The code is modular and easy to maintain, compliant with current industry standards.

The main goal of the service is to attractively present the resort's amenities – including cozy rooms, seasonal Dutch chalets, and a SPA with a jacuzzi and sauna – and to provide a smooth, comprehensive online booking process. The key challenge solved by the platform is converting user interest into confirmed stays through an efficient self-service system.

challenge.title: Goal: Digital Transformation in the Accommodation Industry
challenge.text: Leśniczówka Wieżyca required a digital transformation focused on maximizing conversions, where the main challenge was converting initial user interest into confirmed stays. This was achieved by implementing a self-service online booking system integrated with a new, responsive platform. The result is the automation of accommodation sales processes, which minimizes manual workload and increases the facility's direct revenue.

hero.title: Accommodation Booking & Dynamic Pricing System
hero.description: A configurable, scalable system for managing vacation lodge rentals. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB, it offers a flexible pricing engine, automated reservations, Stripe payment gateway integration, and a dedicated admin panel.

challenge.title: Goal: Creating a Rental Management System
challenge.text: The system was created in response to a client's needs from the vacation lodge rental industry, who required greater flexibility in managing prices and reservations than standard solutions available on the market could offer. Existing tools proved too limited in terms of pricing configuration and business rules, so I designed a system enabling full control over pricing logic and the booking process, while maintaining ease of use. The system architecture was designed in a modular way, allowing it to be easily adapted to other properties and rental models with similar characteristics.

solution.title: My Solution: Full-Stack Platform
solution.text: I designed and implemented a booking system that includes both a landing page with dynamic pricing and a system management panel. The system allows adding an unlimited number of properties, independently configuring their parameters (e.g., guest limits), and dynamically managing prices based on seasons, weekdays, and tiered pricing for different guest count ranges. The application integrates with the Stripe payment gateway and was designed to be easily adapted by other resorts.

searchFeatures.title: Landing Page & Guest Interface
searchFeatures.description: I designed a landing page that showcases the offer and allows for booking, with real-time pricing logic running in the background.

f1.description: Availability Check: Guests instantly check available lodges, while the system verifies date collisions in real-time and dynamically calculates prices.

f2.description: Advanced Pricing Engine: Automatic cost calculation based on seasons, weekend/weekday rates, and tiered pricing depending on the number of guests.

f3.description: Booking Process: A step-by-step form that persists data in local storage, preventing data loss on mobile devices.

f4.description: Stripe Payments: Before generating the payment gateway link, the system re-verifies date availability to eliminate the risk of double bookings.

f5.description: Email Notifications: After making a reservation and receiving payment confirmation from the Stripe system (Webhook), the client receives an email with booking confirmation and details.

f6.description: Mobile-First UI: Design adapted for mobile devices.

f3.description: Manual Booking Creation: Ability to add reservations manually through the management panel, including availability checking and automatic price calculation.

f4.description: Scalable Infrastructure: Ability to add an unlimited number of properties, each with its own configuration for maximum adults, children, and extra beds.

items.f2: Double-Booking Prevention: Implementation of a multi-stage availability verification mechanism – the system checks dates at every step of the booking process and right before payment, eliminating error risks.
items.f3: Flexible Pricing Algorithm: Created an advanced pricing engine (Special Price > Seasonal > Base) that accounts for different weekend/weekday rates and tiered pricing based on the number of guests.
items.f4: Stripe Integration: Integrated the Stripe API for payments along with webhook handling, ensuring flawless synchronization of booking and payment statuses.
items.f5: Communication Automation: The system automatically sends email notifications to the client and administrator after a new reservation, and also informs the client about any reservation modifications made by the system operator.

hero.title: Off-Work: Multi-Tenant Leave Management System
hero.description: Off-Work is a multi-tenant SaaS platform that lets companies register as their own organisation and manage their employees' holidays and leave requests. Every tenant works in complete isolation, with its own employees, departments, leave policies, closure days and approval workflows. Employees submit requests and check their balances in seconds, while managers and HR review requests and plan around shared, real-time calendars.

solution.title: Solution: A Self-Service SaaS for HR Teams
solution.text: Instead of spreadsheets and e-mail threads, Off-Work centralises the entire leave process in one place. It is built as a modern Next.js 16 application using the App Router, TypeScript and the Mantine component library, and secured end-to-end by Better Auth's organization and admin plugins. A two-layer security model — an edge middleware cookie check reinforced by full server-side session verification — keeps every tenant's data isolated, while transactional e-mails are delivered through Resend and React Email. MongoDB with Mongoose stores the data model (employees, departments, leave requests and closure days), and Mantine charts plus Recharts power the analytics.

f1.description: Leave Balance: Real-time allowance, used and remaining days per leave type, so employees always know exactly how much holiday they have left before they submit a request.

f2.description: Personal Calendar: A single date picker marks the employee's approved leave in green, colleagues' approved leave in blue and company closure days in grey, so everyone can see at a glance who is off.

f3.description: Submit a New Request: A guided form with a date-range picker that blocks already approved dates, bank holidays and closure days, counts working days automatically and shows the remaining balance for the selected leave type.

f4.description: My Leave Requests: A filterable, sortable history of all requests, split into current and past leave, with colour-coded status badges (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled).

f1.description: Team Dashboard: A manager's home view showing who is off today together with the number of absentees, upcoming leave across the team, and the newest requests waiting to be reviewed — so everything that needs attention is visible at a glance.

f2.description: Team Calendar: A schedule with week, month and year views that visualises time off per employee and per leave type, with department filters and closure days overlaid.

f3.description: Request Approvals: Managers review, approve or reject requests from a single queue filtered by status and sorted by submission date, with confirmation modals and instant notifications.

f4.description: Absence Reporting & List: Report absences on behalf of employees and browse a complete list of all recorded absences, filtered by employee, department, leave type and date range.

f5.description: Employee Management: A directory of every employee in the organisation with their department, employment details, leave allowances, and per-employee calendars and history.

f6.description: Employee Invitations: Invite new team members by e-mail with a secure, time-limited link (valid for 7 days) that lets them create their account and join the organisation, with the option to resend an invitation at any time.

f7.description: Leave Policies: Define leave types together with their annual allowances, carry-over and accrual rules per organisation, so every employee's balance is calculated correctly.

f8.description: Email Notifications: Transactional e-mails built with React Email and delivered through Resend keep employees and managers informed about new requests, approvals, rejections and password resets.

f9.description: Company Closure Days: Add your own company closure days — shutdown periods, office closures and the like — which are then excluded from working-day counts and shown across every calendar.

f10.description: Bank Holiday Import: Import official UK bank holidays (England & Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland) straight from the official source, so public holidays are always up to date.

f11.description: Reports & Analytics: Monthly and weekly charts plus tables covering leave usage, sick leave, tenure and turnover per department.

achievements.title: Architecture & Solutions:
achievements.f1: Multi-Tenant Architecture: Tenancy is handled through Better Auth's organization plugin as the single source of truth, and every Employee profile is scoped to an organizationId — guaranteeing complete data isolation between companies.
achievements.f2: Two-Layer Security Model: An edge middleware performs a fast cookie-presence check, while auth.api.getSession() verifies the full cryptographic session and role server-side inside the layout files.
achievements.f3: Route Groups & Roles: A clean split between the (marketing), (auth), (app)/me and (app)/team route groups maps directly onto the Employee, Manager and HR roles, enforced consistently on the server.
achievements.f4: Typed Data Layer: Mongoose models (Employee, Department, LeaveRequest, ClosureDay) together with shared TypeScript types keep the whole data layer type-safe and predictable.
achievements.f5: Transactional Email: Password reset, e-mail verification and other notifications are built with React Email and delivered through Resend.
achievements.f6: Working-Day Engine: Utilities that combine bank holidays and company closures to count working days correctly across every request and calendar view.
achievements.f7: Responsive, Accessible UI: Mantine UI components, dark/light colour schemes and fully responsive calendar and table views for phones, tablets and desktops.

f1.title: Less admin overhead:
f1.description: Automated balances, working-day counting and approvals remove hours of manual HR work every month.

f2.title: Full visibility:
f2.description: Real-time calendars and a team dashboard surface availability and pending requests before they become a staffing problem.

f3.title: Multi-tenant by design:
f3.description: Every company is an isolated organisation with its own employees, departments, policies and data — a single deployment serves many customers.

f4.title: Audit-ready reporting:
f4.description: Charts and tables on leave usage, sick days, tenure and turnover give HR and finance the numbers they need, when they need them.

f5.title: Secure & extensible:
f5.description: Role-based access, transactional e-mail and a typed, component-based codebase make the platform safe to run and easy to grow.
